# Memelord

Memelord generates and edits image and video memes from prompts, with hosted results and asynchronous video rendering.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/memelord/.

## Actions

- **Edit Image Meme**: Create a paid edited image-meme render from a prior generation result.
- **Edit Video Meme**: Start a paid asynchronous render that edits a prior video meme's caption and can replace its audio with an overlay, which mutes the base…
- **Generate Image Memes**: Generate 1-10 hosted image memes from a prompt.
- **Generate Video Memes**: Start 1-5 paid asynchronous video-meme renders from a prompt and return job IDs.
- **Get Video Render Status** (read-only): Get the current state of one asynchronous video render job and, when completed, its temporary MP4 URL.
